name: amfx-crude-geopolitical-2024-research
description: amFX reproduction (13JUN25 p1): NYMEX Crude Oil Oct-Nov 2024 showing the Iran-Israel geopolitical reaction. The 68-to-78 move took weeks in Oct 2024. Key annotations: Iran launches 200 ballistic missiles (Oct 1), Israel retaliates and verbal de-escalation (late Oct). The original also shows a Jun 2025 intraday panel where the same move happened in one hour, but we reproduce only the Oct-Nov 2024 daily panel. Source: amFX 13JUN25 newsletter (Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets).
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: CRUDE OIL OCT-NOV 2024 GEOPOLITICAL REACTION
# =============================================================================
# Reproduces the top panel of page 1 chart from amFX 13JUN25 newsletter.
# NYMEX Crude Oct-Nov 2024: the $68 to $78 rally took several weeks.
# Iran launched 200 ballistic missiles (Oct 1) triggering the move.
# Israel retaliated and verbal de-escalation led to fade.
# The Jun 2025 intraday panel (same move in 1 hour) cannot be reproduced
# due to data availability, so we focus on the daily Oct-Nov 2024 view.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
idx = index()

xy_lines(
    title='NYMEX Crude Oct/Nov 2024: The 68-to-78 Move Took Weeks',
    category='Crude Geopolitical',
    y_axis_label='Price (USD/bbl)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='WTI Close', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=68.0, title='$68 Floor (Iran Missiles)', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=78.0, title='$78 Peak (Israel Retaliation)', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=73.0, title='$73 Mid-Range', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=idx, y_values=close)
